rows.note: For a news bulletin or short news report, this is the all-purpose choice.

example.english: TV is broadcasting the latest bulletin right now.
example.traditional: 電視而家播緊最新嘅新聞報道。
example.jyutping: din6 si6 ji4 gaa1 bo3 gan2 zeoi3 san1 ge3 san1 man4 bou3 dou6

rows.note: Use this for an official notice circulated by a company, school, or organization.

example.english: The school issued a bulletin saying classes are suspended tomorrow.
example.traditional: 學校出咗通告，聽日停課。
example.jyutping: hok6 haau6 ceot1 zo2 tung1 gou3 ting1 jat6 ting4 fo3

rows.note: Use this when the official bulletin is a media-facing press release intended for publication or broadcast.

example.english: The company has issued a bulletin for the media to publish.
example.traditional: 公司已經發出新聞稿，交俾傳媒刊登。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 ji5 ging1 faat3 ceot1 san1 man4 gou2 gaau1 bei2 cyun4 mui4 hon1 dang1

rows.note: Use this for a regular newsletter or bulletin produced by an organization.

example.english: The association sends a bulletin to members every quarter.
example.traditional: 協會每季都會寄通訊俾會員。
example.jyutping: hip3 wui6 mui5 gwai3 dou1 wui5 gei3 tung1 seon3 bei2 wui4 jyun4
